subject: Request: Expert lift + shadow swap for final-stage candidate loop
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Expert lift + shadow swap for final-stage candidate loop

Hi all,

Quick context: Jordan Ellis (final-stage SRE hire) has a full-loop scheduled Fri 15 Apr, 11:00–12:00 PT. Marcus, you were original owner for the infra system deep-dive, but you flagged a conflicting customer call — thanks for the heads up.

We need an "expert lift" (senior infra engineer) to cover Marcus's technical slot and ideally one person to shadow the loop for calibration/debrief continuity. Goal is to avoid rescheduling the candidate if possible.

Options I'm proposing (please reply with availability):
- Option A: Monica takes Marcus's 11:00 slot on Fri and Laura backfills one of her morning commitments so Laura can join as backup shadow for the debrief (preferred).
- Option B: Swap Marcus's slot with Laura earlier that day (Laura takes 11:00, Marcus takes Laura's 09:30), Monica shadows.
- Option C: Move the loop to Thu 14 Apr 14:00 PT if none of the above works (candidate is tentatively open).

Attached: loop_prep_notes.pdf and candidate_schedule.ics (calendar invite stub). The prep doc includes the infra rubric and three targeted prompts.

Can each of you confirm in the next couple hours? We should lock the panel by EOD so recruiting can finalize calendar and candidate prep.

Thanks — Priya

Priya Natarajan
Talent Partner, Hiring Operations
Redwood Inference

Sorry, team — confirmed conflict with a customer escalation that I can't move. I can be available for a 20–30 minute async debrief after the loop if that helps (I can do notes and score the infra rubric based on the recording).

If you need a direct replacement in the live slot, I recommend we pull in a senior SRE; I can reach out to Rishi or Karthik if you want me to (they're both heads-down on delivery but may be able to cover). Otherwise, Option A or C above are the right moves.

Happy to be flexible on swapping with Laura if that clears on her side — I can take an earlier slot but only until 10:30 PT.

— Marcus

Thanks everyone for the quick replies — final plan below: 

- Monica will take the live infra deep-dive at Fri 15 Apr, 11:00–12:00 PT.
- Laura will join as backup shadow/debrief lead and cover if Monica runs into a conflict.
- Marcus will provide async notes within 2 hours of the loop and will score the infra rubric from the recording.
- Jordan (candidate) confirmed Friday works and prefers not to move past 1pm PT — leaving the scheduled time intact.

I uploaded the final loop pack to the Drive and updated Greenhouse with the infra rubric link. Attached are the loop_prep_notes.pdf and the calendar invite stub (candidate_schedule.ics). Please review the three targeted prompts in the prep doc and add any last-minute asks by EOD Thu.

If anything changes (e.g., last-minute availability issues) reply-all and we'll trigger Option C (move to Thu) as the fallback.

Thanks — Priya
